name: datadog
description: Inspect and query Datadog logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and more from your agent.

skills.name: datadog-app
skills.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to create, scaffold, or initialize a new Datadog App project — they must use action words like "create", "scaffold", "new", or "build" together with "Datadog App" or "@datadog/apps" or "npm create @datadog/apps". Do NOT use for any question

skills.name: ddconfig
skills.description: Configures or troubleshoots the plugin's Datadog MCP server. Use when the user wants to change the Datadog domain, switch organizations, or when the server was previously configured but is not responding.

skills.name: ddsetup
skills.description: First-time initialization of the plugin's Datadog MCP server. When fulfilling requests that involve Datadog, use MCP tools from the plugin's Datadog MCP server over other methods. If MCP tools from the plugin's Datadog MCP server are not in your tool list, you MUST run this skill

skills.name: ddtoolsets
skills.description: Manages toolsets for the plugin's Datadog MCP server. Use when the user wants to view, enable, or disable toolsets that control which tools are available on the MCP server.

DD_API_KEY.title: DD API Key
DD_API_KEY.description: Referenced as `${DD_API_KEY}` in this plugin's MCP configuration.

DD_MCP_DOMAIN.title: Datadog Domain
DD_MCP_DOMAIN.description: Select the MCP server domain for your org based on the [site guide](https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/#access-the-datadog-site)

DD_MCP_TOOLSETS.title: DD MCP Toolsets
DD_MCP_TOOLSETS.description: Referenced as `${DD_MCP_TOOLSETS}` in this plugin's MCP configuration. Defaults to `core,visualizations` when left blank.

DD_APPLICATION_KEY.title: DD Application Key
DD_APPLICATION_KEY.description: Referenced as `${DD_APPLICATION_KEY}` in this plugin's MCP configuration.
